title: Mute Video – Remove Audio from Video Free, No Upload
description: Remove the sound from a video right in your browser. The picture is copied as it is, H.264, HEVC, VP9 or AV1, so its quality stays the same. No upload.
heading: Remove Sound from a Video
subtitle: Take the sound out of a video in one click; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Remove background noise, voices or music before you share a clip. It is the quick way to take out music before you post a clip, or the background chatter from a screen recording. The picture is copied without being encoded again, whether it is H.264, HEVC from a recent iPhone, VP9 or AV1, so the result looks exactly like your video and is ready in seconds, even for a long recording.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your video is changed by your own browser and never sent anywhere.

features.title: Same picture
features.text: H.264, HEVC, VP9 and AV1 pictures are copied as they are, with no loss of quality.

features.title: Quick
features.text: When the picture is copied, even a long video is done in seconds.

steps.title: Choose a video
steps.text: Pick a video or drop it on the page.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Play the silent video and download it.

handles: Formats: MP4, WebM, MOV and MKV keep their format; other videos become MP4.
Picture: copied unchanged, whatever its codec: H.264, HEVC, VP8, VP9, AV1 or ProRes.
Sound: the sound track is taken out completely, so players show the video as having no sound, not as a silent track.
limits: The whole sound is removed; to silence only a part, trim the video first.
Only the first chosen video is muted.
faqTitle: Questions about removing sound from a video

faq.question: Is my video uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your own browser removes the sound on your device, and nothing is sent to a server. Open your browser's network panel while it runs and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Does muting lower the quality?
faq.answer: No. The picture is copied as it is, not encoded again, so it looks exactly like the original.

faq.question: Can I put different music on instead?
faq.answer: Yes. Use Add audio to video, which replaces the sound with an MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or AAC file.

faq.question: Can I remove the sound from only part of a video?
faq.answer: Not here: the whole sound is removed. Trim the part you need first, or keep the sound and cut the video later.

faq.question: Which browsers does it work in?
faq.answer: Recent Chrome and Edge read and make the most formats; Safari and Firefox work with most videos. If your browser can't read or make a codec, the page names it and says what to try instead.

faq.question: Can I remove the music but keep the voices?
faq.answer: No. This tool takes out the whole sound track; separating music from speech needs an audio editor. You can replace the sound instead: mute the video, then use Add audio to video with a voice recording or royalty-free music.
